text:
You need a Tableau trainer who can teach people not just the tool, but how to use data to solve business problems and create real value.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data visualization, SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. I enjoy helping others understand data clearly and confidently.

In a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports, cutting monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. I also built an HR attrition dashboard for a confidential manufacturing client, covering 1,900 employees and helping identify attrition hotspots in 2 plants.

I’d be glad to support your virtual Tableau training sessions with clear communication, strong analytical thinking, and a practical, business-focused teaching style.
